bio: Convivial and buzzing Bar Raket provides a chic industrial-style setting in which to share a variety of delectable dishes. Flavours from all over the globe are represented here in cuisine that is all about enjoying the simple things: from Catalan bread to the umami of tonkatsu with North Sea crab to super-fresh clams with fried diced guanciale and a delectable hot sauce. The bread is simply divine! With a selection of smaller dishes and three main courses, the menu shows that good food can also be a delightfully laid-back affair....
